title: Sourcing Executive
description:
**We're Hiring \| Sourcing Executive** 




**Location: Tiruppur \| Experience: 2 \- 4 years in sourcing within a textile industry (MUST)** 




**Education: Textile Technology Graduates** 




  





 ✅
 **About the Role** 




 We are hiring a Sourcing Executive to manage end\-to\-end procurement of trims and accessories for garment production. The role involves vendor development, purchase order management, and ensuring timely availability of materials as per production plans. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to maintain quality, cost efficiency, and smooth supply chain operations in a fast\-paced environment.
 



  





 ✅
 **Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\) Vendor Development \& Management** 



* Identify, evaluate, and onboard new suppliers for sewing trims \& accessories.
* Maintain strong relationships with key vendors to ensure long\-term supply and quality.



**2\)** 
**Procurement Operations** 



* Source trims and accessories based on tech packs/BOMs shared by merchandising or design teams.
* Ensure timely procurement in line with production and delivery schedules.



**3\) Order Management** 



* Issue Purchase Orders (POs) and ensure confirmations, follow\-ups, and tracking until delivery.
* Maintain procurement reports, vendor scorecards, and order status dashboards.



**4\)** 
**Quality \& Compliance** 



* Ensure trims meet quality standards, specs, and buyer requirements.
* Coordinate with QA/QC teams for testing and approvals.



**5\)** 
**Inventory Coordination** 



* Collaborate with the warehouse/stores team for stock levels and reordering plans.
* Avoid excess or shortage of trims by planning with production and merchandising teams.



  





**✅ What Were Looking For:** 



* Strong understanding of garment manufacturing processes and trim requirements.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and strong vendor coordination skills.
* Working knowledge of Excel, ERP systems, and procurement tools.
* Detail\-oriented and deadline\-driven.



  





 Interested candidates may \#Apply Now!
 



 Please note: Candidates will be redirected to a Google Form while applying. Completing the form is mandatory, and applications without a completed form will not be considered.

title: Human Resources Administrator
description:
📢 WE’RE HIRING: HR \& ADMINISTRATION EXECUTIVE / MANAGER
 



 📍 Location: Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
 



 🏢 Company: Robinbosky / ASM Knits
 



 🏭 Industry: Apparel Manufacturing, E\-commerce \& Retail
 



 We are looking for a proactive HR \& Administration Executive / Manager to take ownership of our day\-to\-day HR activities, with a strong focus on recruitment, employee coordination and business administration.
 



 Salary Range \- 18000 to 28000
 



 PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



 1\. Recruitment \& Hiring – Primary Responsibility• Understand manpower requirements from different departments• Create and publish job openings on LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed and other hiring platforms• Source and shortlist suitable candidates• Conduct initial screening calls and interviews• Coordinate interviews with department heads / management• Follow up with selected candidates and manage joining formalities• Maintain an active candidate pipeline for frequently required positions• Coordinate recruitment for office, operations, e\-commerce, warehouse, showroom, administration and managerial roles• Track open positions, interviews, offers, joining dates and hiring status• Reduce hiring delays and ensure vacancies are filled on time
 



 2\. Employee Communication \& HR Coordination• Handle day\-to\-day discussions with employees regarding attendance, leave, responsibilities, work\-related concerns and general HR matters• Act as the first point of contact between employees and management for routine matters• Coordinate onboarding and induction of new employees• Maintain employee records and documentation• Monitor attendance, leave and basic HR compliance• Coordinate salary\-related information with accounts/management• Handle resignations, relieving formalities and exit documentation• Help maintain discipline, accountability and a professional working environment
 



 3\. Business Administration• Handle routine administrative discussions and follow\-ups across departments• Coordinate between management, office staff, operations, warehouse, e\-commerce and other teams• Follow up on assigned tasks and ensure pending matters are closed• Handle routine communication with vendors, service providers and external parties when required• Maintain important office records, documents and administrative information• Coordinate meetings, schedules, appointments and internal communication• Assist management with daily operational and administrative requirements• Identify recurring administrative issues and help establish better processes
 



 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR• Strong communication and people\-handling skills• Good recruitment and candidate\-screening ability• Ability to confidently speak with employees across different levels• Strong follow\-up and coordination skills• Organised and capable of handling multiple responsibilities simultaneously• Comfortable working directly with management• Good working knowledge of MS Office / Google Workspace• Basic understanding of HR documentation, attendance, payroll coordination and labour\-related processes• Ability to take ownership rather than waiting for continuous instructionsExperience in HR, recruitment, administration, apparel/textile manufacturing, e\-commerce, retail or MSME environments will be an advantage.
 



 IDEAL CANDIDATE We are looking for someone who enjoys talking to people, finding the right candidates, solving day\-to\-day issues and keeping the organisation moving smoothly.This is not a purely documentation\-based HR role.The person should be comfortable spending a significant part of the day on:
 



 Hiring → Calling → Interviewing → Coordinating → Following up → Resolving → Closing📩 Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or send their resume with current salary, expected salary, notice period and current location.

title: Medical Laboratory Technician
description:
**Company Description** 
 Dr. Mohan's Diabetes Specialities Centre (DMDSC) is a leading diabetes care institution in India, founded by renowned specialists Dr. V. Mohan and the late Dr. Rema Mohan. Over the past 33 years, DMDSC has grown to 50 centers nationwide and has provided care to more than 1,000,000 patients. The centre offers comprehensive services covering diabetes management, advanced diagnostics, eye and foot care, cardiovascular care, diet and nutrition counseling, and weight management. DMDSC also provides telemedicine and home care services, ensuring convenient access to high\-quality, patient\-centered care. The organization is committed to improving diabetes outcomes and enhancing the quality of life for every individual it serves.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Medical Laboratory Technician will perform routine and specialized laboratory tests to support diabetes diagnosis, monitoring, and management. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include collecting and processing samples, operating and maintaining laboratory equipment, adhering to standard operating procedures, and documenting results accurately in laboratory information systems. The role involves working closely with clinicians and clinical staff to ensure timely and reliable test reporting, participating in quality control and safety programs, and maintaining a clean, compliant laboratory environment. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based at Dr. Mohan's Diabetes Specialities Centre in Tiruppur.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundation in medical technology and laboratory medicine, with the ability to perform relevant diagnostic tests accurately and safely.
* Proficiency in core laboratory skills, including sample collection, handling, preparation, and basic troubleshooting of test procedures.
* Experience with quality control practices, including calibration, validation, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and accreditation standards.
* Hands\-on experience with laboratory equipment, including operation, routine maintenance, and reporting equipment\-related issues promptly.
* Diploma or degree in Medical Laboratory Technology or a related field from a recognized institution.
* Knowledge of clinical safety, infection control, and biomedical waste management protocols.
* Attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and ability to work efficiently in a high\-volume clinical environment.
* Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary healthcare teams.
* Prior experience in a clinical laboratory setting, preferably in endocrinology or diabetes care, is an advantage.

title: Merchandiser
description:
**Company Description** 








 Raaha Garments, headquartered in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, is a reputed apparel export house with over 40 years of expertise in supplying premium knitwear and woven garments to leading global brands. The company's product range includes infants, kids, men’s, women’s, and licensed merchandise, specializing in fabrics like Single Jersey, Rib, and French Terry, among others.
 



  





**Role Description** 








 This is a full\-time, on\-site Merchandiser role located in Tiruppur. The Merchandiser will be responsible for managing client communications, coordinating production schedules, and ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality garments. Day\-to\-day tasks include liaising with the design and production teams, ensuring adherence to customer specifications, and monitoring the entire process from order placement to final shipment. Additionally, the Merchandiser will handle market trends analysis to provide insights for product development and maintain effective customer relationships.
 



  





**Qualifications** 







* Excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to engage with clients and address their requirements effectively.
* Strong Sales and Retail experience to understand customer preferences and drive business growth.
* Knowledge of Marketing strategies to support product promotion and foster strong brand partnerships.
* Organizational skills for managing schedules, timelines, and multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams including design and production teams.
* Familiarity with garments manufacturing processes and quality assurance is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Merchandising, Business, or related field is highly desirable.
